author: Jonathan Yantis
selection: Every900 future physical witness for every declared method and frozen control, including unavailable outcomes. Only phase derivatives, relative time and audit aggregates are selected.
redactions: No credentials, SSID/BSSID, factory bindings, absolute UTC, raw packets/serial stream, GNSS location or firmware images.
reproduction_limit: Public analyzer recomputes phase-base subtraction and metrics from selected predictions and fixed prior phase bases, plus a posthoc future counter-rate diagnostic. Native frozen numeric bases were prospectively sealed; continuous bases use a locked prior-only rule and were computed offline. The analyzer does not recreate private software endpoints, physical bridge histories, prior phase-base measurements or full causal estimator replay.
qualification: GNSS-shadow PPS input phase with an estimator-specific prior GNSS calibration; reference/RF/output/UTC bias not calibrated. No GNSS frequency steering. Native gaps never become zero error.
cohort: SL025 historical P1..P3 and SL027 primary R1/R2 are different firmware/boot cohorts. Same image/boot/cadence within each cohort; no cross-cohort causal accuracy attribution.
primary_selection: Both acquired fresh SL027 windows; no phase-based exclusion among acquired windows. Historical outcomes and every unknown remain in the same selected dataset.
termination: Original three-window sequence shortened to two by author instruction after the first result and before the second future window. Third capture was not acquired; it is not a failed or missing trial. Original sealed plan remains preserved.
